threat_event: Ransomware encrypts TOS application servers, the TOS gate servers and office systems, halting vessel, yard and gate operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff remote-access VPN accepts a password only; flat gate and yard network; no EDR on servers; backups reachable from production
existing_controls: MFA on email and TOS administrators; managed antivirus; monthly office patching
treatment_plan: MFA on the VPN and all TOS users; MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 alerting on servers and endpoints; segment gate and yard network; isolated immutable backups (R-004)

threat_event: Attacker moves from the gate and office network into crane and RTG controllers and causes unsafe motion or a stoppage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT shares a flat network with gate servers, OCR and TWIC readers; office-to-yard routing unfiltered; no OT monitoring
existing_controls: Crane hardware safety interlocks and emergency stops; operators in cabs
treatment_plan: Separate OT zone behind an internal firewall with allow-listed flows to the TOS equipment interface; log and alert on every IT-OT connection

threat_event: Compromise of the crane vendor's always-on remote access gives an attacker direct access to STS and RTG PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor appliance with cellular modem; shared vendor account; no MFA; no session logging; no documented justification
existing_controls: Appliance reachable only by the vendor
treatment_plan: Turn remote access off by default; enable per session on approved ticket with named vendor accounts, MFA, recording and time limit; document justification in the Cybersecurity Plan

threat_event: Backups are encrypted or deleted together with production so the TOS cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Database snapshots in the production cloud account under the same administrators; weekly export on a domain-joined device; never restore-tested
existing_controls: 7-day point-in-time restore; weekly export
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention and a second region; offline copy of gate server images and PLC programs; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: A cyber incident is not reported immediately to the FBI, CISA and the Captain of the Port, delaying the coordinated response and breaching 33 CFR 6.16-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written reporting procedure; staff do not know the reporting duty; no CySO
existing_controls: FSO reports physical breaches of security to the NRC under the FSP
treatment_plan: Cyber Incident Response Plan with a reporting checklist and pre-filled contacts (P08); train supervisors

threat_event: Cyber duties stay unowned: no one drives the Cybersecurity Assessment, training and Plan, and the Coast Guard finds noncompliance at inspection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No Cybersecurity Officer designated in writing; IT Manager has part-time security duties
existing_controls: IT Manager acts informally
treatment_plan: Designate the IT Manager as CySO and the FSO as alternate in writing, with a 24x7 contact rota and protected time

threat_event: Untrained staff or longshore workers fall for phishing, plug in unknown media or mishandle OT, and the missed training deadline becomes a Coast Guard deficiency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training deadline of 2026-01-12 missed; 22 of 60 employees trained; no OT-specific or contractor training
existing_controls: Generic online module for 22 employees
treatment_plan: Role-based training for all employees; OT module for maintenance and operations; short briefing for longshore labor through the hiring hall; supervise untrained users (101.650(d)(3))

threat_event: Password guessing succeeds against gate servers and OT HMIs that have no lockout or strength rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local accounts on gate servers and HMIs without lockout or length rules; shared passwords
existing_controls: Identity provider lockout for cloud apps
treatment_plan: Lockout and 14-character minimum on gate servers; compensating controls documented for HMIs that cannot lock out

threat_event: Known exploited vulnerability in the internet-facing VPN or firewall is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning; KEVs not tracked; firmware patched ad hoc
existing_controls: MSP applies firmware when notified by the firewall vendor
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; weekly KEV catalog check; KEV patching or documented compensating control without delay (internal target 7 days)

threat_event: Gate OCR or gate transaction server fails and trucks must be processed manually, backing traffic onto port roads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single servers; OCR operating system near end of support; configurations not backed up
existing_controls: Manual gate procedure in the FSP
treatment_plan: Configuration backups; replace OCR servers before 2026-12; spare gate server image

threat_event: Bay plans and container status messages sent by unencrypted FTP are read or altered in transit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier service still uses plain FTP
existing_controls: Firewall restricts the FTP source address
treatment_plan: Move the carrier to SFTP or AS2

threat_event: Insider or organized crime manipulates container release or hold status in the TOS to steal cargo or move contraband
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad TOS rights for clerks; hold overrides not reviewed; shared gate logins
existing_controls: Customs holds received electronically; gate checks at exit
treatment_plan: Restrict hold override to supervisors; daily report of manual releases and overrides reviewed by the Operations Manager

threat_event: Former employee uses TOS or VPN access after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accounts disabled about 5 business days after the last day
existing_controls: HR emails IT at termination
treatment_plan: Same-day disable in the identity provider and VPN triggered by the HR ticket; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: Shared gate booth logins prevent tracing a fraudulent gate transaction to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Four gate booth workstations use shared gate clerk logins
existing_controls: CCTV covers the gate booth
treatment_plan: Named accounts with fast badge-tap sign-in on gate workstations

threat_event: Hurricane closes the terminal and damages the gate server room or power
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gate server room at grade; single generator; no cyber element in hurricane plan
existing_controls: Port hurricane plan; generator; TOS in cloud
treatment_plan: Add IT and OT shutdown and restart steps to the hurricane plan; raise gate server rack; pre-staged recovery kit

threat_event: Internet outage at the terminal cuts gate and yard systems off from the cloud-hosted TOS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet circuit; no failover
existing_controls: Carrier service level agreement
treatment_plan: Second circuit from a different carrier with cellular backup

threat_event: Cloud region outage makes the TOS unavailable for more than a shift
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TOS deployed in one region (multi-zone)
existing_controls: Multi-zone deployment; provider availability commitments
treatment_plan: Accepted by General Manager: multi-zone design and manual workarounds; revisit when the contingency plan is written

threat_event: TOS vendor remote support account is compromised and used to access the TOS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing vendor support account; access not reviewed
existing_controls: Vendor account uses MFA (TOS administrator group)
treatment_plan: Disable vendor account between approved sessions; log and review vendor sessions; add incident notice clause

threat_event: A compromised partner (carrier, port community system) sends false EDI messages such as bogus vessel schedules or releases
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EDI content accepted without validation against a second source
existing_controls: Customs release status comes from the customs data exchange, not carriers
treatment_plan: Validation rules and exception queue for unusual release or schedule changes

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a vendor or customer payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No payment verification call-back; untrained staff
existing_controls: MFA on email; email filtering
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank detail changes; finance training

threat_event: Attacker deletes local logs so the incident cannot be investigated or evidenced to the Coast Guard
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Logs local with default retention; local administrators can delete them
existing_controls: Cloud audit log (default retention)
treatment_plan: Central log collection with 1-year retention and access limited to privileged users

threat_event: Malware enters an HMI or gate server on USB media or an unmanaged technician laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Open USB ports; no approved software list; own laptops connected to OT
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Block unused ports; scanning kiosk for media; company-owned maintenance laptops; approved list

threat_event: Unauthorized person enters the gate server room or a crane electrical house and tampers with equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gate server room key shared by 11 people; electrical houses keyed alike
existing_controls: Secure area TWIC control; CCTV
treatment_plan: Badge reader on the server room; rekey electrical houses; access log

threat_event: CCTV cameras or the video management server are compromised and used as a foothold or to blind the FSO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Old camera firmware; cameras reachable from the office LAN
existing_controls: Separate camera VLAN
treatment_plan: Firmware update; restrict camera VLAN to the video server

threat_event: Unknown internet-exposed device (for example a cellular modem on an RTG) is found and exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory covers office and gate IT only; no network map; no OT configuration records
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Inventory of all network-connected IT and OT with critical designation; network map; external exposure scan

threat_event: Cybersecurity Plan is not ready for submission by 2027-07-16
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CySO; no Assessment; small team
existing_controls: P01 to P10 deliverables approved 2026-09-04
treatment_plan: Plan project with milestones: Assessment 2027-03-31; draft Plan 2027-04-30; submission 2027-05-31

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through credential theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Four administrators with standing access
existing_controls: MFA on the TOS administrator group; conditional access
treatment_plan: Accepted by IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Scheduling optimization produces an unsafe or infeasible yard or berth plan that planners approve without checking
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot has no output validation rules or monitoring (P10)
existing_controls: Planners approve every plan; advisory mode only
treatment_plan: Hard constraint checks for hazardous cargo segregation and stack weight; planner sign-off; monthly accuracy review (P10)

threat_event: Scheduling model systematically disadvantages some carriers or trucking companies, raising an unreasonable-preference complaint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fairness testing of berth windows or appointment slots
existing_controls: Planners follow terminal services agreements
treatment_plan: Quarterly fairness test by carrier and trucking company size (P10)

threat_event: During a TOS outage no one can produce the current location of hazardous cargo containers for emergency responders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hazardous cargo list lives only in the TOS
existing_controls: Vessel dangerous goods manifests on paper per call
treatment_plan: Hourly automated export of the hazardous cargo yard list to the FSO and a printer in the security office

threat_event: TWIC reader or PACS outage or a stale canceled card list lets an unauthorized person into a secure area
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PACS server on the flat network; card list update not monitored
existing_controls: Security officers check TWICs visually when readers fail (FSP)
treatment_plan: Monitor card list update job; move PACS into the security zone (R-002 work)

threat_event: A security researcher or partner reports a vulnerability and the report is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No channel to receive publicly reported vulnerabilities; no threat sharing process
existing_controls: FSO attends Area Maritime Security Committee meetings
treatment_plan: Security contact on the website; intake procedure; join a maritime information sharing organization

threat_event: Attacker uses manufacturer default passwords on 2 RTG HMIs or the OCR camera controllers to change settings or pivot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords found in P07 testing on 2026-08-12
existing_controls: Devices on internal network only
treatment_plan: Change default passwords; add check to commissioning checklist
